rows.grounds: compound of kāla (time) and grāsa (devouring); nominative subject
optative expressing possibility or prescribed result
compound of nānā (various), anubhava (experience), and bhūmi (realm/ground); locative plural indicating domains

items.question: In what manner does the devouring of time persist across diverse experiential realms?
premises: The culmination described is a devouring of time.
It manifests within various realms of experience.
items.inference: Therefore temporal limitation is perpetually dissolved across all experiential domains.
items.plain_english: May there constantly be the devouring of time in the various realms of experience.
